text:
📍 Lago di Braies, South Tyrol, Italy 🇮🇹

Turquoise waters reflect the towering Dolomite peaks and surrounding evergreen forests.

Wooden rowboats add to the charm of this spectacular alpine lake.

Would you take a boat ride here?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Dolomites

📍 Banff Avenue, Alberta, Canada 🇨🇦

This charming mountain street offers stunning views of the Canadian Rockies, with shops, cafés and colourful buildings lining the road.

A beautiful blend of small-town charm and alpine scenery.

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Banff

📍 Maldives 🇲🇻

Turquoise lagoons, white-sand beaches and palm-fringed islands make this Indian Ocean paradise unforgettable.

Beneath the clear waters lies a spectacular world of coral reefs and marine life.

Would you visit?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Maldives

📍 Paleokastritsa, Corfu, Greece 🇬🇷 

Dramatic green hills and rocky cliffs frame beautiful turquoise bays along the Ionian Sea. 

Crystal-clear waters and hidden coves make this coastal village a Mediterranean gem. 

Would you swim here?

text:
📍 Forrest Gump Point, Utah, USA 🇺🇸

U.S. Route 163 stretches toward Monument Valley’s towering red sandstone buttes, creating one of America’s most iconic road views.

Made famous by the film Forrest Gump, it’s a dream for road trips.

Would you stop for a photo?

📍 Moraine Lake, Banff National Park, Canada 🇨🇦

Brilliant turquoise water reflects the towering Ten Peaks, creating one of the Canadian Rockies’ most iconic views.

Surrounded by pine forests and mountain peaks, it’s pure alpine beauty.

Would you visit?

📍 Finnish Lapland, Finland 🇫🇮

This magical natural display makes winter in Lapland unforgettable.

Would you travel north to see the aurora?
